# Bulachak

> A future we build together.

Bulachak means "the future" in Tatar. It brings together three branches: Agents 4 Athletes for practical support in sport, Parafencing 4 Progress for access to adaptive fencing, and Immigrant 4 Immigrant for community and mutual support.

The Emerald Pasture is built on co-opetition: people can both compete and cooperate. Sharing knowledge and combining strengths within clear agreements can grow total value instead of only dividing a fixed pool. Human alignment first, AI second.

The homepage introduces the three branches. The separate work directory presents founder Kamilla Gafurzianova's earlier projects as experience informing Bulachak. Those case studies describe her role, the work's status, and available evidence; they are not presented as completed outcomes of the developing branches.

## Available language editions

- [English homepage](/portfolio)
- [Главная страница на русском](/ru/portfolio)
- [Татарча баш бит](/tt/portfolio)

## The three branches

- [A4A: Agents 4 Athletes](/portfolio/a4a): Commercial engine. Developing practical tools and operations support for athletes, clubs, and sports organizations.
- [P4P: Parafencing 4 Progress](/portfolio/p4p): Nonprofit branch in development. A vision for equipment, coaching, and support that makes participation easier.
- [I4I: Immigrant 4 Immigrant](/portfolio/i4i): Immigrant support. Mutual support, shared knowledge, and cultural continuity across immigrant communities.
